fields.Name: IT154 - Video Data Snapshot
fields.Description: Deterministic server-transport integration checks (VDS1–VDS3) for Video Studio CaptureDataSnapshot and LoadDataSnapshotValues against live Row-Level Security and entity permissions on MJ: AI Agent Runs: user A sees only A's row, user B sees only B's row, it-nogrant records an Error issue with no rows and no throw, and LoadDataSnapshotValues round-trips the captured Values with a valid AsOf timestamp and Sources list.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: User A and User B each capture only their own RLS-scoped row; no-grant user records an Error issue with no rows; LoadDataSnapshotValues round-trips Values with valid AsOf and Sources.
